briefing.headline: xAI Colossus cluster hits 1M H100s as OpenAI o4 multi-agent rollout accelerates

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs shipping agentic systems this quarter. Compute buildouts continue at unprecedented scale while regulatory scrutiny mounts globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3.0 Pro both launched with extended context windows exceeding 2M tokens. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B while DeepSeek and xAI traded benchmark leads on coding agents.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with applications expanding into automotive CAN bus and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and CoreWeave announced joint 200MW data center expansions. TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips with NVIDIA securing first allocation. Oracle and xAI completed the Colossus Phase 3 cluster.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent frameworks reach autonomous scientific discovery before 2028 or will safety bottlenecks slow deployment?
